passages.title: 주문 배송 지연 사과 메일
passages.passage:
From: Cozy Home Store
To: Rita Vaughn
Subject: About Your Order #8812

Dear Ms. Vaughn,

We are sorry to tell you that your bookshelf order will arrive three days later than planned, on April 9. Heavy snow closed our warehouse for two days.

As an apology, shipping is now free, and the fee you paid has been returned to your card. Track your order anytime with the link below.

Cozy Home Customer Care

questions.q: Why is the order delayed?
questions.exKo: 폭설로 창고가 이틀간 닫혀 배송이 늦어졌습니다.

questions.q: When will the order arrive?
questions.exKo: arrive three days later than planned, on April 9라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What did the store do as an apology?
questions.exKo: 배송비를 무료로 하고 지불한 요금을 카드로 환불했습니다.

passages.title: 회의록 검토 요청 메일
passages.passage:
From: Peter Shaw
To: Project Team
Subject: Minutes from Today's Meeting

Hi team,

Attached are the minutes from today's planning meeting. Please read them and send me any corrections by Thursday noon.

The main decisions: the launch moves to September 5, and Maria will lead the test group. Our next meeting is Monday at 10 in Room 3.

Thanks,
Peter

questions.q: What are team members asked to do?
choices: Check the minutes and send corrections
questions.exKo: 회의록을 읽고 목요일 정오까지 수정 사항을 보내 달라는 요청입니다.

questions.q: What was decided about the launch?
questions.exKo: the launch moves to September 5라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: When is the next meeting?
questions.exKo: next meeting is Monday at 10 in Room 3에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 분실물 보관함 정리 공지
passages.passage:
LOST AND FOUND CLEAROUT

The lost and found box at the front desk is full. If you have lost gloves, umbrellas, cups, or badges this year, please check the box by Friday, March 28.

Unclaimed items will be photographed and posted on the intranet for one week, then donated to charity. Valuable items such as phones are kept separately by security.

Front Desk Team

questions.q: What should people do by March 28?
choices: Check the lost and found box
questions.exKo: 분실물 보관함이 가득 차 3월 28일까지 확인해 달라는 공지입니다.

questions.q: What happens to unclaimed items?
questions.exKo: posted on the intranet for one week, then donated to charity라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: Who keeps valuable items?
questions.exKo: Valuable items such as phones are kept separately by security에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 회의 없는 수요일 공지
passages.passage:
NO-MEETING WEDNESDAYS

Starting next month, Wednesday mornings will be meeting-free across the company. No meetings may be scheduled between 9 a.m. and noon.

This quiet time is for focused work on your own tasks. Urgent issues can still be discussed, but please try messaging first. The change will be reviewed after three months based on your feedback.

Operations Office

questions.q: What is the new rule?
questions.exKo: 수요일 오전을 회의 없는 집중 근무 시간으로 정한다는 공지입니다.

questions.q: What is the quiet time for?
choices: Focused work on one's own tasks
questions.exKo: for focused work on your own tasks라고 설명합니다.

questions.q: When will the change be reviewed?
questions.exKo: reviewed after three months based on your feedback에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 출근길 아침 세트 광고
passages.passage:
MORNING RUSH SET — BEAN & BAGEL

Grab breakfast without slowing down! Our Morning Rush Set — coffee, a bagel, and fruit — is just $5.50 before 9 a.m. on weekdays.

Order on our app and your set will be waiting on the pickup shelf; no line, no waiting. Find us on the ground floor of the Union Building, beside the subway entrance.

questions.q: What is the Morning Rush Set?
choices: A breakfast set of coffee, a bagel, and fruit
questions.exKo: 커피, 베이글, 과일로 구성된 아침 세트 광고입니다.

questions.q: When is the special price available?
questions.exKo: just $5.50 before 9 a.m. on weekdays라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What is the benefit of ordering on the app?
questions.exKo: 앱으로 주문하면 픽업 선반에서 바로 가져갈 수 있어 줄을 서지 않아도 됩니다.

passages.title: 명함 지갑 각인 서비스 광고
passages.passage:
PERSONALIZED CARD HOLDERS — GIFT SHOP LUNA

Looking for a gift for a coworker? Our leather business card holders come in five colors, and we engrave a name or initials for free.

Each holder is $19, or three for $50 — perfect for your whole team. Engraving takes one hour. Open daily 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. at Westfield Mall, second floor.

questions.q: What product is advertised?
questions.exKo: 이름을 새겨 주는 가죽 명함 지갑 광고입니다.

questions.q: What is free with each holder?
questions.exKo: we engrave a name or initials for free라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: How much are three holders?
questions.exKo: three for $50라고 명시되어 있습니다.

passages.title: 시청 앞 푸드트럭 구역 기사
passages.passage:
ASHFORD — A permanent food truck zone opened in the plaza in front of City Hall on Monday. Eight trucks will serve lunch on weekdays from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.

The city chose the trucks from 60 applicants, changing the lineup every three months to keep the menu fresh. Tables and umbrellas are provided, and card payment is required at all trucks.

questions.q: What opened in front of City Hall?
questions.exKo: 시청 앞 광장에 상설 푸드트럭 구역이 문을 열었다는 기사입니다.

questions.q: How often will the truck lineup change?
questions.exKo: changing the lineup every three months라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What is required at all trucks?
questions.exKo: card payment is required at all trucks에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 퇴근 후 목공 클래스 인기 기사
passages.passage:
MILLER CREEK — Evening woodworking classes at the Maker House studio are booked out two months ahead. Most students are office workers who want to build something with their hands after a day at a desk.

Beginners make a small stool in four weekly sessions; the fee includes wood and tools. Owner Sofia Reyes plans to add morning weekend classes to shorten the waiting list.

questions.q: What is popular at Maker House?
questions.exKo: 저녁 목공 클래스가 두 달치 예약이 찰 만큼 인기라는 기사입니다.

questions.q: What do beginners make?
questions.exKo: Beginners make a small stool in four weekly sessions라고 설명합니다.

questions.q: Why will morning weekend classes be added?
questions.exKo: to shorten the waiting list에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 정장 수선 완료 문자
passages.passage:
Stitch Tailor (12:20 P.M.)
Hello Mr. Grant, your navy suit is ready. The sleeves were shortened as requested.

Harry Grant (12:35 P.M.)
Great, thank you. What time do you close today?

Stitch Tailor (12:36 P.M.)
We close at 7 P.M. The fee is $22, card or cash.

Harry Grant (12:38 P.M.)
I'll stop by around 6 after work. Could you press the jacket too?

Stitch Tailor (12:39 P.M.)
Of course, no extra charge. See you at 6.

questions.q: Why did the tailor message Mr. Grant?
choices: His suit is ready for pickup
questions.exKo: 수선한 정장이 준비되었음을 알리는 메시지입니다.

questions.q: What was done to the suit?
questions.exKo: The sleeves were shortened as requested에서 확인됩니다.

questions.q: What will the tailor do for free?
questions.exKo: 재킷 다림질을 추가 요금 없이 해 주겠다고 합니다.

passages.title: 신입 환영 준비 문자
passages.passage:
Bella Ross (4:30 P.M.)
Hi Owen, our new designer starts Monday. Is her desk ready?

Owen Fox (4:33 P.M.)
Almost. Monitor and chair are set. Her laptop arrives tomorrow.

Bella Ross (4:34 P.M.)
Good. Don't forget the welcome kit — notebook, mug, and badge.

Owen Fox (4:36 P.M.)
Already on the desk. Should I book a lunch table for the team on Monday?

Bella Ross (4:37 P.M.)
Yes, for eight people at noon. Thanks, Owen!

questions.q: What are the two people preparing for?
questions.exKo: 월요일에 입사하는 신입 디자이너 맞이 준비를 하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What arrives tomorrow?
questions.exKo: Her laptop arrives tomorrow에서 확인됩니다.

questions.q: What will Mr. Fox book?
questions.exKo: book a lunch table ... for eight people at noon이라고 확인합니다.
